title: Ad Creative Specs by Network
deck: Creatives that violate a network's spec either don't serve or get auto-cropped, cutting off the core message. This doc standardizes the size matrix, the 5MB playable constraint, and video safe zones.
summary: Every network's creative specs change yearly. This guide is current as of May 2026 — re-verify quarterly. Playables enforce the IAB Mobile RB Standard (5MB); place key text inside each network's safe zone (top/bottom ~15%).

items: 5MB hard limit: HTML5 + JS + images combined. Use WebP/AVIF; fall back to system fonts
Load within 1.5 seconds: networks reject playables that take too long to first interaction
3 required elements: (1) a clear action cue within the first second, (2) a simulation of core gameplay/features, (3) a closing CTA (install button)
iframe isolation: network SDKs run playables inside an iframe — no external domain calls. Inline every resource as base64

content.html: 9:16 vertical video gets covered by each network's UI overlays (like button, username, CTA). Keep key text inside the safe zone.

content.title: Playable rejected in network review
content.html: 1) Over 5MB (measured after GZIP decompression). 2) External domain calls (api.example.com etc.) — inline everything. 3) Auto-redirects or auto-clicks — the CTA must follow an explicit user action.

content.title: Key video info gets covered (TikTok)
content.html: The bottom-35% safe zone wasn't respected. Place captions/pricing/CTA text in the middle or upper half. For multi-country creatives, set safe zones based on the longest-text language.
